heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of the corporation are—

tree.text: to collect, analyze, develop, and disseminate in the public interest information and recommendations about—

children.text: radiation measurements, quantities, and units, particularly those concerned with protection against radiation;

tree.text: to provide a means by which organizations concerned with the scientific and related aspects of protection against radiation and of radiation quantities, units, and measurements may cooperate for effective use of their combined resources, and to stimulate the work of those organizations;

children.text: the application of those concepts; and

tree.text: to cooperate with the International Commission on Radiological Protection, the Federal Radiation Council, the International Commission on Radiological Units and Measurements, and other national and international organizations, governmental and private, concerned with radiation quantities, units, and measurements and with protection against radiation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15090236:4503.July 14, 1964, Pub. L. 88–376, § 3, 78 Stat. 321. In this section, the word “objects” is omitted as unnecessary. The words “protection against radiation” are used throughout, and the words “(referred to herein as ‘radiation protection’)” in 36:4503(1) are omitted, for clarity and to eliminate unnecessary words.
